Name: Vassago's Emblem
Basic Side: When an air units wins combat, give the next air unit -1 power on their priority check
Condition: If 4 Unkengeister are in the exhaust zone at once: Transform Vassago
Ultimate Side: Your Basic Ability is still active and usable. Once per round, before a duel: swap one of your air units in the exhaust with the air unit about to duel. The enemy unit gets -1 Base Power during that combat.
For AI notes: The Attack Power is NOT part of the base power but is added addtionally when the unit triggers it ability priority.  ULTIMATE SIDE PROPOSED BY CLAUDE (round AE, your Q100) - edit it freely, it is built in C8.
